environment.configuration: 2D Release, normal -O2, KIN_DEV_FAST_SCRIPTING OFF, PCH ON, compiler cache OFF, LTO OFF, mold
environment.host_activity: Unrelated compilation and video rendering were observed during this round. Per-sample load averages are retained.

implementation.move: SpriteInstance moved byte-for-byte from backend.hpp to sprite_instance.hpp; backend.hpp still includes and exports the type.
implementation.queue: render_queue.hpp includes sprite_instance.hpp instead of backend.hpp.
implementation.consumer_repair: tests/tilemap_tests.cpp defines FakeBackend and now includes backend.hpp directly; the initial Clang validation build exposed this indirect dependency.
implementation.compatibility: Users of unrelated backend types that previously obtained them through render_queue.hpp need their own backend.hpp include. SpriteInstance fields, defaults, and layout and all existing method bodies are preserved.
implementation.contracts: 11 separate renderer header translation units, including queue and instance, with PCH and unity disabled.

plan_method.method: Append a comment temporarily, run Ninja -n against a copy of the generated manifest in the configured build directory to avoid dry-run CMake glob regeneration, restore bytes and nanosecond timestamps. Each phase starts with a clean plan.
plan_method.real_build_cross_check: All four completed backend-header edits produced exactly their planned object sets.

timing_method.scope: backend.hpp edit through hex_demo link, affected sources/game PCH/archives/link included; unrelated objects/dependencies/shaders prebuilt
timing_method.command: GNU time around taskset -c 0,2,4,6 cmake --build BUILD --parallel 4 --target hex_demo
timing_method.order: Before Clang/GCC, after GCC/Clang; one completed sample per version/compiler, separate phases rather than interleaved.
timing_method.interpretation: Exploratory single observations with varying external load. Counts are the primary result; no controlled percentage wall-speedup or full clean-build improvement is claimed.
timing_method.restoration: Restore header bytes/timestamps after each edit, then rebuild measured game PCHs against the restored header and repeat smoke/API/no-change checks.
timing_method.memory: RSS is maximum child process, not concurrent aggregate.

layout_validation.scope: sizeof/alignof of 14 types including SpriteInstance, RenderQueue and PreparedSprite; Flip numeric values; Clang/GCC, render-probe on/off.

syntax_selection.method: Transitive repository include consumers of render_queue.hpp or sprite_instance.hpp

limits: Header-edit counts are specific to these configurations and targets; they do not imply the same improvement to clean builds or game-source edits.
One timing observation per compiler/version with varying background activity is not a controlled speedup ratio.
Optional 3D checks are syntax/template compilation only; no Windows/MSVC or full 3D/GPU runtime validation in this round.

steps: Prepare persistent builds per compiler and prebuild the three targets at base_commit using the recorded configuration; adjust paths and TMPDIR.
Run queue_fanout.py before, queue_layout.py before and queue_measure.py before.
Apply the change; run queue_validate.py, queue_layout.py after and queue_syntax.py clang gcc clang-3d. Repair direct includes and recheck failures if needed.
After validation compilations finish, run queue_fanout.py after and queue_measure.py after.
Save the expected changed backend header as expected-backend.hpp before timing; run queue_restore.py and queue_mechanical.py. Finally run queue_record.py.

import concurrent.futures,json,os,pathlib,re,shlex,subprocess,sys,time
repo=pathlib.Path('/home/bamedeo/kin-wt/build-time');base=pathlib.Path('/mnt/windows/Users/amedeo/Desktop/gamedev');out=base/'kin-queue-backend-bench';env={**os.environ,'TMPDIR':str(base/'kin-queue-backend-tmp')};selected=sys.argv[1:] or ['clang','gcc','clang-3d'];tasks=[]
# Follow repository includes backwards from the queue/instance headers to audit
# every known consumer, including tests and optional 3D, without PCH.
parents={}
for folder in ['engine','tests','games']:
 for path in (repo/folder).rglob('*'):
  if path.suffix not in ['.cpp','.hpp','.h','.inl']:continue
  for name in re.findall(r'^\s*#\s*include\s*[<"]([^>"]+)[>"]',path.read_text(errors='replace'),re.M):
   for candidate in [path.parent/name,repo/'engine/include'/name]:
    if candidate.is_file():
     parents.setdefault(candidate.resolve(),set()).add(path.resolve());break
pending=[repo/'engine/include/kin/renderer/render_queue.hpp',repo/'engine/include/kin/renderer/sprite_instance.hpp'];affected=set()
while pending:
 path=pending.pop().resolve()
 if path in affected:continue
 affected.add(path);pending.extend(parents.get(path,[]))
(out/'syntax-selection.json').write_text(json.dumps({'method':'Transitive repository include consumers of render_queue.hpp or sprite_instance.hpp','sources':sorted(str(p.relative_to(repo)) for p in affected if p.suffix=='.cpp')},indent=2)+'\n')
for mode in selected:
 build=base/{'clang':'kin-build-time-clang','gcc':'kin-build-time-out','clang-3d':'kin-build-time-3d-clang'}[mode]
 for entry in json.loads((build/'compile_commands.json').read_text()):
  source=pathlib.Path(entry['file'])
  if source.suffix!='.cpp' or not source.resolve().is_relative_to(repo) or source.resolve() not in affected:continue
  only=set(filter(None,os.environ.get('KIN_HEADER_SYNTAX_ONLY','').split(',')))
  if only and str(source.resolve().relative_to(repo)) not in only:continue
  args=shlex.split(entry['command']);cmd=[];i=0
  while i<len(args):
   if args[i:i+2] in [['-Xclang','-include-pch'],['-Xclang','-include']] and i+3<len(args) and args[i+2]=='-Xclang' and 'cmake_pch.' in args[i+3]:i+=4;continue
   if args[i] in ['-include','-include-pch'] and i+1<len(args) and 'cmake_pch.' in args[i+1]:i+=2;continue
   if args[i]=='-o':i+=2;continue
   if args[i] in ['-c','-fpch-preprocess','-Winvalid-pch','-fpch-instantiate-templates']:i+=1;continue
   cmd.append(args[i]);i+=1
  cmd.append('-fsyntax-only');relative=str(source.resolve().relative_to(repo));tasks.append((mode,build,relative,cmd))
# Report production errors before tests to speed up dependency repairs.
tasks.sort(key=lambda t:('/tests/' in '/'+t[2],not any(x in t[2] for x in ['/renderer/','/particles/','/tilemap/','/ecs/']),t[0],t[2]))
def check(task):
 mode,build,relative,cmd=task;log=out/('syntax-'+mode+'-'+relative.replace('/','_')+'.log');started=time.monotonic()
 with log.open('w') as f:r=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=build,env=env,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 row={'configuration':mode,'source':relative,'exit_code':r.returncode,'wall_seconds':round(time.monotonic()-started,3),'pch':False}
 if r.returncode:print('FAIL '+mode+' '+relative+'\n'+log.read_text()[:5000],flush=True)
 return row
rows=[]
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as pool:
 for future in concurrent.futures.as_completed([pool.submit(check,t) for t in tasks]):
  rows.append(future.result());(out/('syntax-results-'+'-'.join(selected)+('-targeted' if os.environ.get('KIN_HEADER_SYNTAX_ONLY') else '')+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'checked':len(rows),'failures':sum(r['exit_code']!=0 for r in rows)}),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(any(r['exit_code'] for r in rows))
